description: Get the full details of one Google shopping product: merchant offers, images, description, specifications, reviews and related products. Pass a productResultToken from scrape_google (result.shoppingCards[] or result.aioverview.inlineProducts[]) or scrape_google_ai_mode (result.shoppingCards[] or result.inlineProducts[]). A token lasts at most 5 minutes from the scrape that issued it, so call this tool directly after that scrape. Returns result.productResults with one product. A 410 (productResultTokenExpired) means the token expired: run the scrape again to get a new token. A 404 (productResultTokenUnknown) means the token is not recognized. A 502 means Google returned no usable product data. Costs 3 credits (1 base + 2 sync surcharge); charged only when the product is returned.

productResultToken.description: The productResultToken value from a shopping card or inline product of a scrape_google or scrape_google_ai_mode result. Send it unchanged.

name: get_google_product
title: Get a Google product
